source: Nautilus_20000_Leagues_RPG_Revamped.html (pictures only; the text is new — see build_twenty_thousand_leagues.py)
title: Twenty Thousand Leagues: The Sealed Log — Past Perfect Deep-Sea RPG (B1-B2)
grammar: Past perfect simple and continuous, anchored on a later past moment; past simple and present perfect as the distractors

intro.badge: 40 STORY SCREENS · 15 LOG ENTRIES · MULTIPLE ROUTES
intro.story: The Nautilus came home in 1868 and her log was sealed. Now it is open. Every page tells what had already happened in the dark before the crew understood it. Read the log, and give each entry the tense that makes it true.

brief.title: BEFORE THAT MOMENT
brief.story: Every entry looks back from THEN, never from NOW: what was already finished, and what was still going on?

rules.head: PAST PERFECT SIMPLE
rules.body:
a result or a number, complete before a past moment
had + past participle

rules.head: PAST PERFECT CONTINUOUS
rules.body:
an activity still going on up to a past moment
had been + -ing

rules.head: THE ANCHOR
rules.body:
by the time · when · before · already
the moment the entry looks back from

q0.story: The log opens on the third night: a faint pulse under the Atlantic, and a captain who would not leave the bridge.
q0.prompt: By the third night, Nemo ___ for the source of the signal for three days.
q0.fb: A duration (for three days) and an activity still running at that past moment: had been searching.

leak.title: THE HULL ANSWERED BACK
leak.story: A seam opened near the ballast chamber. Lia sealed it with her own hands, and the Nautilus went on with a scar.

route.story: Two ways lay below. Nadia saw a crystal trench pulsing with the signal. Mara, the cartographer, saw a ruined temple whose gate carried the same symbol.
route.prompt: Where did Nemo take the Nautilus?

c1.story: Sunrise was hours behind them when the crystals below flared like a second sun.
c1.prompt: When the crystals flared, the divers ___ for six hours.
c1.fb: Six hours of one activity, still going on at the moment the crystals flared: had been descending.

cbad.title: A SHADOW CROSSED THE LIGHT
cbad.story: The dive team lost air correcting course. Beyond the crystals, something enormous moved.

c2.story: Giant clams covered the trench floor. Nadia counted the team's find before they turned back.
c2.prompt: By the time they turned back, the divers ___ six black pearls.
c2.fb: A number of finished results before a past moment: had collected. The continuous cannot count pearls.

cdec.kicker: BRANCH II · A VOICE IN THE TRENCH
cdec.story: A broken diving lamp flashed beneath a ledge. At the same moment, the signal surged deeper into the canyon.

crescue.story: Nadia reached the trapped diver. A rock was pinning his air line, but he was still conscious.
crescue.prompt: When Nadia reached him, he ___ for help for nearly twenty minutes.
crescue.fb: Twenty minutes of calling, still going on when Nadia arrived: had been calling.

csignal.story: They left the flashing lamp behind and chased the pulse. A turquoise structure rose beyond the canyon wall.
csignal.prompt: By the time the structure appeared, the signal ___ three times stronger.
csignal.fb: A completed change before a past moment, measured as a result (three times stronger): had become.

c4.story: A glass dome lay under the reef. Mara checked the chart against its impossible geometry and found nothing.
c4.prompt: No explorer ___ this structure before that day.
c4.fb: Before that day = before a past moment. A result that did not exist yet: had recorded.

t1.story: The Nautilus passed between stone guardians. Warm lights were glowing inside the ruins.
t1.prompt: Before the crew understood the lights, the Nautilus ___ a hidden coral city.
t1.fb: One completed discovery, earlier than the moment of understanding: had found.

tbad.title: THE GATE CLOSED
tbad.story: The current pushed the Nautilus against the gate. The starboard plates buckled before Nemo forced her through.

t2.story: Mara stood at a wall of carved symbols with a lamp. One phrase repeated: THE EYE BELOW.
t2.prompt: When the lamp failed, Mara ___ the symbols for an hour.
t2.fb: An hour of one activity, interrupted at a past moment: had been translating.

tdec.story: A narrow archive hall led left. A flooded tunnel beneath a statue led down. Both carried the same turquoise mark.

tarchive.story: Aronnax opened a cabinet of stone tablets. Most had crumbled in the water long before.
tarchive.prompt: By the time the cabinet was empty, Aronnax ___ three readable tablets.
tarchive.fb: Three tablets is a countable result, complete before the past moment: had saved.

tstatue.story: Nadia swam under the guardian to a metal door. It hummed with the signal, and the hum was not new.
tstatue.prompt: When Nadia touched it, the door ___ since the Nautilus entered the city.
tstatue.fb: Since + a past starting point, and still going on when Nadia touched it: had been vibrating.

t4.story: Behind the door, Mara found a chart etched onto a black plate. It marked a structure deeper than the city.
t4.prompt: Before the plate was found, the crew ___ only the first part of the route.
t4.fb: A completed part of a task, before a past moment: had decoded.

log.story: Back aboard, Aronnax closed the journal before the next alarm and counted.
log.prompt: By the time the alarm sounded, Aronnax ___ seven pages.
log.fb: Seven pages is a result you can count, complete before the alarm: had written.

engine.story: The pressure drive screamed. Lia and her mechanics had not left it since the last impact.
engine.prompt: When the drive screamed, Lia and the mechanics ___ on it for two hours.
engine.fb: For two hours, and still at it when the drive screamed: had been working.

ballast.title: TOO LATE
ballast.story: A ballast valve stuck open. Lia could still save the ship, but the repair would be harder now.

repairdec.story: Lia offered two plans. She could stay inside and rebuild the pressure drive, or Nadia could go outside and repair the damaged intake by hand.

i1.story: Lia lifted out the damaged regulator. The mechanics watched the temperature fall.
i1.prompt: By the time the temperature fell, Lia ___ the broken regulator.
i1.fb: The temperature fell because the job was already complete: had replaced.

i2.story: The new regulator held, but the coolant pipes were still unstable.
i2.prompt: When Lia checked them, the pipes ___ steam since the impact.
i2.fb: Since the impact, and still leaking when she checked: had been leaking.

i3.story: One by one, the turquoise lamps came back on. Lia read the board.
i3.prompt: Before the lamps came on, the engineers ___ all four emergency circuits.
i3.fb: All four circuits is a completed count before the lamps lit: had restored.

o1.story: Nadia left the airlock. The current pulled at her line while she moved toward the intake.
o1.prompt: When the current caught her line, Nadia ___ along the hull for twelve minutes.
o1.fb: Twelve minutes of movement, still going on when the current caught her: had been crawling.

o2.story: Nadia worked along a row of fractures. Inside, Lia watched the repair counter climb.
o2.prompt: By the time Lia called her back, Nadia ___ five fractures.
o2.fb: Five fractures is a number, complete before the call: had sealed.

o3.story: The sonar operator saw a huge shape behind Nadia. It stayed below the light, patient.
o3.prompt: When the sonar found it, the creature ___ the Nautilus for several minutes.
o3.fb: Several minutes of following, still going on when the sonar found it: had been following.

squidq.story: A colossal eye opened beyond the reef. Tentacles unfolded around the ship, and Nemo reached for the controls.
squidq.prompt: Before the first tentacle struck, the lookout ___ the eye twice.
squidq.fb: Twice is a counted result, complete before the strike: had seen.

tentacle.title: THE SHIP TILTED
tentacle.story: A tentacle caught the stern and tore away an outer rail. The Nautilus rolled, and the lamps went out for a moment.

finaldec.story: The archive signal lay beyond the squid. Nemo saw two possibilities: lure the creature into the crystal trench, or race through the coral city and use the ruins as cover.

routes.text: Lure it into the crystal trench

ft1.story: Nadia released a trail of luminous pearls. The squid followed the moving lights toward the trench.
ft1.prompt: By the time the squid turned, Nadia ___ forty pearls into the current.
ft1.fb: Forty pearls, a counted result before the squid turned: had released.

ft2.story: The squid kept coming. Its tentacles scraped the walls while Nemo pushed deeper.
ft2.prompt: When Nemo reversed the engines, the squid ___ them for a full mile.
ft2.fb: A mile of chasing, still going on at the moment Nemo reversed: had been chasing.

ft3.story: Nemo reversed the engines. The squid struck the crystal wall, and the Nautilus slipped past.
ft3.prompt: By the time the crystal dust settled, the Nautilus ___ the creature.
ft3.fb: The escape was complete before the dust settled: had escaped.

fc1.story: The Nautilus raced between towers. Mara called out a route through the collapsed arches.
fc1.prompt: When the chase reached the towers, Mara ___ the ruins since the first alarm.
fc1.fb: Since the first alarm, and still mapping as the chase went on: had been mapping.

fc2.story: The squid smashed a tower behind them. Ahead, three arches were still open.
fc2.prompt: By the time they reached the arches, the squid ___ two towers.
fc2.fb: Two towers, a counted result before they reached the arches: had destroyed.

fc3.story: The last arch was barely wider than the hull. Nemo took it at full speed.
fc3.prompt: When the last arch came into view, the Nautilus ___ through passages like it for ten minutes.
fc3.fb: Ten minutes of the same activity, still going on when the arch appeared: had been squeezing.

archive.story: Two figures stood at the mouth of the archive. Nemo did not speak for a long time.
archive.prompt: By the time the doors opened, the expedition ___ the heart of the archive.
archive.fb: Arrival is a completed result, and it came before the doors opened: had reached.
